rootActions.query: INSERT INTO games (name, time_compression, status, created_by_user_id, duration, stars_per_player, start_time, end_time, event_counter, last_action_time, ended, ended_at, public_id, result_published_at, paused, paused_at, total_paused, auto_resume_at, is_private, join_code, join_code_created_at, generated_map, autopilot_enabled, factory_cost, spy_probe_cost, death_probe_cost, speed_cost, battle_power_cost, range_cost, probe_shield_cost, death_shield_cost, gate_cost_per_k, map_type, saved_map_name, starting_ships, starting_cash) VALUES (%(name)s::VARCHAR, %(time_compression)s, %(status)s, %(created_by_user_id)s::INTEGER, %(duration)s, %(stars_per_player)s::INTEGER, %(start_time)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(end_time)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(event_counter)s::INTEGER, %(last_action_time)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(ended)s, %(ended_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(public_id)s::UUID, %(result_published_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(paused)s, %(paused_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(total_paused)s, %(auto_resume_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(is_private)s, %(join_code)s::VARCHAR, %(join_code_created_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(generated_map)s, %(autopilot_enabled)s, %(factory_cost)s::INTEGER, %(spy_probe_cost)s::INTEGER, %(death_probe_cost)s::INTEGER, %(speed_cost)s::INTEGER, %(battle_power_cost)s::INTEGER, %(range_cost)s::INTEGER, %(probe_shield_cost)s::INTEGER, %(death_shield_cost)s::INTEGER, %(gate_cost_per_k)s::INTEGER, %(map_type)s::VARCHAR, %(saved_map_name)s::VARCHAR, %(starting_ships)s::INTEGER, %(starting_cash)s::INTEGER) RETURNING games.id

-- 30 times
INSERT INTO players (game_id, user_id, abandoned_at, name, wealth, battle_power, range, speed, final_rank, final_stars, last_action_at, autopilot_since, autopilot_last_pass_at, autopilot_warned_at, autopilot_opt_out) SELECT p0::INTEGER, p1::INTEGER, p2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, p3::VARCHAR, p4::INTEGER, p5::INTEGER, p6::FLOAT, p7::FLOAT, p8::INTEGER, p9::INTEGER, p10::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, p11::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, p12::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, p13::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, p14::BOOLEAN FROM (VALUES (%(game_id__0)s::INTEGER, %(user_id__0)s::INTEGER, %(abandoned_at__0)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(name__0)s::VARCHAR, %(wealth__0)s::INTEGER, %(battle_power__0)s::INTEGER, %(range__0)s, %(speed__0)s, %(final_rank__0)s::INTEGER, %(final_stars__0)s::INTEGER, %(last_action_at__0)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_since__0)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_last_pass_at__0)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_warned_at__0)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_opt_out__0)s, 0), (%(game_id__1)s::INTEGER, %(user_id__1)s::INTEGER, %(abandoned_at__1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(name__1)s::VARCHAR, %(wealth__1)s::INTEGER, %(battle_power__1)s::INTEGER, %(range__1)s, %(speed__1)s, %(final_rank__1)s::INTEGER, %(final_stars__1)s::INTEGER, %(last_action_at__1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_since__1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_last_pass_at__1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_warned_at__1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(autopilot_opt_out__1)s, 1)) AS imp_sen(p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, sen_counter) ORDER BY sen_counter RETURNING players.id, players.id AS id__1

-- 24 times
INSERT INTO stars (game_id, name, x, y, wealth, num_ships, num_factories, has_spy_shield, has_death_shield, owner_id, home_world_of_id, is_dead) SELECT p0::INTEGER, p1::VARCHAR, p2::INTEGER, p3::INTEGER, p4::INTEGER, p5::INTEGER, p6::INTEGER, p7::BOOLEAN, p8::BOOLEAN, p9::INTEGER, p10::INTEGER, p11::BOOLEAN FROM (VALUES (%(game_id__0)s::INTEGER, %(name__0)s::VARCHAR, %(x__0)s::INTEGER, %(y__0)s::INTEGER, %(wealth__0)s::INTEGER, %(num_ships__0)s::INTEGER, %(num_factories__0)s::INTEGER, %(has_spy_shield__0)s, %(has_death_shield__0)s, %(owner_id__0)s::INTEGER, %(home_world_of_id__0)s::INTEGER, %(is_dead__0)s, 0), (%(game_id__1)s::INTEGER, %(name__1)s::VARCHAR, %(x__1)s::INTEGER, %(y__1)s::INTEGER, %(wealth__1)s::INTEGER, %(num_ships__1)s::INTEGER, %(num_factories__1)s::INTEGER, %(has_spy_shield__1)s, %(has_death_shield__1)s, %(owner_id__1)s::INTEGER, %(home_world_of_id__1)s::INTEGER, %(is_dead__1)s, 1)) AS imp_sen(p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, sen_counter) ORDER BY sen_counter RETURNING stars.id, stars.id AS id__1
UPDATE games SET paused=%(paused)s, paused_at=%(paused_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE games.id = %(games_id)s::INTEGER

children.query: INSERT INTO contracts (game_id, offerer_id, recipient_id, amount, status, condition_kind, condition_origin_id, condition_destination_id, condition_num_ships, accepted_event_id, settlement_event_id, expires_at) VALUES (%(game_id)s::INTEGER, %(offerer_id)s::INTEGER, %(recipient_id)s::INTEGER, %(amount)s::INTEGER, %(status)s, %(condition_kind)s::VARCHAR, %(condition_origin_id)s::INTEGER, %(condition_destination_id)s::INTEGER, %(condition_num_ships)s::INTEGER, %(accepted_event_id)s::INTEGER, %(settlement_event_id)s::INTEGER, %(expires_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) RETURNING contracts.id, contracts.created_at

rootActions.query:
SELECT contracts.id, contracts.game_id, contracts.offerer_id, contracts.recipient_id, contracts.amount, contracts.status, contracts.condition_kind, contracts.condition_origin_id, contracts.condition_destination_id, contracts.condition_num_ships, contracts.accepted_event_id, contracts.settlement_event_id, contracts.created_at, contracts.expires_at 
FROM contracts 
WHERE contracts.id = %(pk_1)s::INTEGER
